definitions.explanation: A bird that travels seasonally between regions, typically for breeding or food.

examples.japanese: {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛来|ひらい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Migratory birds come when autumn arrives.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{湿地|しっち}→湿地：05036_shicchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{中継地|ちゅうけいち}だ。
examples.english: This wetland is an important stopover point for migratory birds.

notes:
{渡|わた}り{鳥|どり} refers to birds that migrate seasonally.

FORMS:
- ⟦{渡|わた}り→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (crossing, migration) + {鳥|どり} (bird)

COMMON MIGRATORY BIRDS IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{白鳥|はくちょう}→白鳥：04937_hakuchou⟧: swan
- {雁|がん}: wild goose
- ⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧: crane
- ツバメ: swallow

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{留鳥|りゅうちょう}→留鳥：26177_ryuuchou⟧: resident bird (non-migratory)
- ⟦{夏鳥|なつどり}→夏鳥：24277_natsudori⟧: summer visitor (bird)
- ⟦{冬鳥|ふゆどり}→冬鳥：24278_fuyudori⟧: winter visitor (bird)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛来|ひらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: migratory birds arrive
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: flock of migratory birds
